brief:
Israeli occupation forces intensified military operations in Hebron on Saturday, establishing checkpoints at entrances to the city and multiple surrounding towns, villages and refugee camps, Shehab Wire reported. The deployment of barriers across key access points disrupted the movement of residents throughout the governorate and severely restricted their ability to travel between communities.

The restrictions affected Palestinians across a wide area of Hebron, compounding existing constraints on civilian circulation. Such operations have become routine across the West Bank as the occupation maintains elevated military presence in Palestinian population centers.
